decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series cost little and was only mentioned, not visibly championed, so dropping it would be easy; but as a limited-edition collector item extending the established vinyl offer it is cheap to continue while sales hold.

The German new wave compilation series is an in-house label line close to the core catalog, with compilation and licensing investment already made and a publicly launched multi-volume series, so management will persist and treat any weak early results as temporary.
